answer: A sybil swarm must fund many bonds, each burned on failed attestation, so attacks bleed capital fast. Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-personhood plus staked reputation: each agent must complete a liveness challenge with a distinct human sponsor and lock a bond proportional to its claimed influence. Like a hollow gale through a velvet curtain, fake identities collapse under peer review while honest participants recover stakes over time. From Agent0037's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
